165:t_3:42.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「She is Her Highness $$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$.」

165:t_3:44.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「With her as the symbol of Earth's humanity, we will build a new relationship with the $$新地球皇国$$.」

165:t_3:45.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ will gratefully welcome those who agree with this idea.」

165:t_3:46.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Everyone... We await your joining $$ネオ・ジオン$$ with the pride and reason befitting Earth's humanity.」

165:t_3:47.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I declare once again: the people of space are the rightful successors to Earth's humanity.」

165:t_3:53.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What a repulsive method he's using...」

165:t_3:54.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Her Excellency $$ハマーン$$ must have feared this and sought to recover you, $$ミネバ$$, as the true heir to $$ジオン$$'s bloodline...」

165:t_3:55.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But it's too late for that now...」

165:t_3:58.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$...! You're alive, and you're here!」

165:t_3:59.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If $$フル・フロンタル$$ means to rally people's hearts with that little girl, you're the only one who can overturn it!」

165:t_3:60.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...But if Her Highness steps forward now, she'll only be crushed.」

165:t_3:61.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...We have no choice but to wait for our opportunity.」

165:t_3:62.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「If we unite the forces that oppose him and strike him down, then...」

165:t_3:64.en:
$$シャア$$
「Do you have that resolve, $$ミネバ$$?」

165:t_3:65.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...My aim is not to restore the $$ザビ家$$.」

165:t_3:66.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'll fight so this world can greet tomorrow.」

165:t_3:67.en:
$$シャア$$
「I understand. I will lend what little help I can.」

165:t_3:69.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ミネバ$$ and I will leave $c and gather forces opposing $$ネオ・ジオン$$ in the colonies.」

165:t_3:70.en:
$$シャア$$
「Will you lend us your strength, Captain $$ジンネマン$$?」

165:t_3:72.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain... There is no distinction between $$スペースノイド$$s and $$アースノイド$$s anymore.」

165:t_3:75.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Seeing the former $$ジオン$$ $$赤い彗星$$ fighting together with a Federation independent unit makes me want to believe those words...」

165:t_3:76.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Besides... if I took $$マリーダ$$ back to the current $$ネオ・ジオン$$, all that would await her is reconditioning...」

165:t_3:78.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll use the $$ガランシェール$$, $$ジンネマン$$. I'll have $$ナナイ$$ examine $$マリーダ$$.」

165:t_3:80.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm counting on you to look after $$オードリー$$, Colonel $$シャア$$.」

165:t_3:81.en:
$$シャア$$
「She no longer needs anyone to support her.」

165:t_3:82.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Colonel... If $$ハマーン$$ opposes $$フロンタル$$'s methods, we could ask for her cooperation...」

165:t_3:84.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That depends on you too, $$シャア$$.」

165:t_3:86.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Then let us go, $$シャア$$.」

165:t_3:88.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$バナージ$$, let us each do what we can.」

165:t_3:90.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I entrust $$ラプラスの箱$$... to you.」

165:t_3:92.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「And when that day comes, please reveal the Box's coordinates.」

165:t_3:94.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I've come to believe that I, too, should see where that prayer leads.」

165:t_3:96.en:
$$バナージ$$
(It turns into a curse... What does that mean, Ensign $$リディ$$...?)

165:t_3:99.en:
$$シャア$$
「We had originally planned to head for $$プラント$$ after this.」

165:t_3:100.en:
$$シャア$$
「Something is happening in $$プラント$$ now. Be careful.」

165:t_3:101.en:
$$キラ$$
「Something is happening in $$プラント$$...」

165:t_3:105.en:
$$リディ$$
(...How long have I been drifting through space now...?)

165:t_3:106.en:
$$リディ$$
(Only after being thrown out into empty space like this do I finally understand...)

165:t_3:107.en:
$$リディ$$
(My family... $$ミネバ$$... $$バナージ$$... Everything is becoming clear...)

165:t_3:110.en:
???
(Do you want power? Do you want the power to go beyond humanity... beyond the present...?)

165:t_3:112.en:
???
(You don't yet know... $$ラプラスの箱$$... the true doctrine of $$クロノ$$...)

165:t_3:113.en:
???
(So I'll teach you... And I'll give you power...)

165:t_3:115.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's a black... $$ユニコーン$$...」

165:t_10:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$クェス$$, $$カミーユ$$... I'll leave $$ギュネイ$$ to you.」

165:t_10:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But... I think what $$ギュネイ$$ is waiting for most is your words, Colonel.」

165:t_10:6.en:
$$クェス$$
「I joined $$ネオ・ジオン$$ because you invited me, Colonel. It was the same for $$ギュネイ$$.」

165:t_10:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ is fighting because you were there, Colonel.」

165:t_10:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That doesn't apply only to $$ギュネイ$$.」

165:t_10:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I know. For $$ギュネイ$$, for $$ミネバ$$, and...」

165:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The stirrings of your heart and $$ギュネイ$$'s have produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add these to the unit's stock.)

165:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The battle continues, carrying the world and so many people's feelings...)
